% !TEX root = ../main-draft.tex

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Common Code Listing Styles
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

\definecolor{listing-comment}{rgb}{0.68,0.68,0.68}
\definecolor{listing-string}{rgb}{0, 0, 0.5}%
\definecolor{listing-keyword-traits}{rgb}{0.75, 0, 0}% traits
\definecolor{listing-keyword-types}{rgb}{0, 0.5, 0}% primitive types
\definecolor{listing-keyword-const}{rgb}{0, 0.5, 0}% type and value constructors
\definecolor{listing-keyword-macro}{rgb}{0, 0, 0.75}% macros
\definecolor{listing-keyword}{rgb}{0, 0, 0}% macros
\definecolor{listing-identifier}{rgb}{0, 0, 0.75}% macros

% the basic style for the code listings
\newcommand{\lstbasicstyle}{\ttfamily\footnotesize}

% style for list numbering
\newcommand{\lstnumberstyle}{\tiny\color{gray}}

% keyword style
\newcommand{\lstkeywordstyle}{\bfseries\color{listing-keyword}}

%

\lstdefinestyle{common}
{
  %
  % 4.3.2 Space and placement
  %
  %
  %
  % 4.3.3 The printed range
  %
  % start line enumeration with line 1000
  firstnumber=1
  %
  %
  %
  % 4.3.5 Figure out the appearance%
  %
  % the size of the fonts that are used for the code
  , basicstyle=\lstbasicstyle
  % identifier style
  , identifierstyle=\color{listing-identifier}
  % comment style
  , commentstyle=\itshape\color{listing-comment}
  % string literal style
  , stringstyle=\color{listing-string}
  % keyword style
  , keywordstyle=\lstkeywordstyle
  %
  %
  % 4.3.6 Getting all characters right
  %
  % lets you use non-ASCII characters; for 8-bits encodings only, does not work with UTF-8
  , extendedchars=false
  % sets default tabsize to 2 spaces
  , tabsize=2
  % show tabs within strings adding particular underscores
  , showtabs=false
  % show spaces everywhere adding particular underscores; it overrides 'showstringspaces'
  , showspaces=false
  % underline spaces within strings only
  , showstringspaces=false
  %
  %
  % 4.3.7 Line numbers
  %
  % where to put the line-numbers; possible values are (none, left, right)
  , numbers=left
  % the step between two line-numbers. If it's 1, each line will be numbered
  , stepnumber=2
  % The first line of each listing gets numbered
  , numberfirstline=false,
  % the style that is used for the line-numbers
  , numberstyle=\lstnumberstyle
  % how far the line-numbers are from the code
  , numbersep=5pt
  %
  %
  % 4.3.8 Captions
  %
  % a title without any numbering or label.
  % , title= asdf,
  % the caption of the listing
  % , caption = {[short]asdt},
  % % the label of the listing
  %, label = asdf,
  % sets the caption-position to bottom
  , captionpos=b
  %
  %, abovecaptionskip = \smallskipamount
  %, belowcaptionskip = \smallskipamount
  %
  %
  % 4.3.9 Margins and line shape
  %
  % sets automatic line breaking
  , breaklines=true
    % sets if automatic breaks should only happen at whitespace
  , breakatwhitespace=true
  % the auto indent for beaks
  , breakautoindent=true
  %
  %
  % 4.3.10 Frames
  %
  % draws a frame none|leftline|topline|bottomline|lines|single|shadowbox
  , frame=none
  % if not set, the frame-color may be changed on line-breaks within not-black text
  , rulecolor=\color{black}
  %
  %
  % 4.3.12 Column alignment
  %
  % column alignment fixed, flexible, spaceflexible, or fullflexible
  , columns=[c]fixed
  % keeps spaces in text, useful for keeping indentation of code (possibly needs columns=flexible)
  , keepspaces=true
  %
  %
  % if you want to add LaTeX within your code (*@\label{comment}@*)
 , escapeinside={(*@}{@*)}
}

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Language Specific Options
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% Prolog Style Definition
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

\lstdefinestyle{coloredProlog}
{
  % set the langauge
  language=Prolog
  % set the base style
  , style = common
  %
  % if you want to delete keywords from the given language
  % , deletekeywords={...}
  % if you want to add more keywords to the set
  % , morekeywords={*,...}
  % some additional comments
  , morecomment=[l]{\//},
}

\lstnewenvironment{codeprolog}
  {\lstset{style=coloredProlog}}
  {}

\lstnewenvironment{codeprologfloat}
  {\lstset{style=coloredProlog,float=ht}}
  {}


% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
% C Style Definition
% ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


\lstdefinestyle{coloredC}
{
  % set the langauge
  language=C
  % set the base style
  , style = common
  %
  % if you want to delete keywords from the given language
  % , deletekeywords={...}
  % if you want to add more keywords to the set
  , morekeywords={uint8_t, uint16_t, uint32_t, uint64_t, inline}
  % some additional comments
  , morecomment=[l]{\//},
}

\lstnewenvironment{codec}
  {\lstset{style=coloredC}}
  {}

\lstnewenvironment{codecfloat}
  {\lstset{style=coloredC,float=ht}}
  {}

\lstdefinestyle{coloredRust}
  {
    % set the langauge
    language=Rust
    % set the base style
    , style = common
    % keyword styles for differnt rust components
    , keywordstyle=\bfseries% reserved keywords
    , keywordstyle=[2]\color[rgb]{0.75, 0, 0}% traits
    , keywordstyle=[3]\color[rgb]{0, 0.5, 0}% primitive types
    , keywordstyle=[4]\color[rgb]{0, 0.5, 0}% type and value constructors
    , keywordstyle=[5]\color[rgb]{0, 0, 0.75}% macros
    %
    % if you want to delete keywords from the given language
    % , deletekeywords={...}
    % if you want to add more keywords to the set
    % , morekeywords={*,...}
    % some additional comments
    , morecomment=[l]{\//},
  }

\lstnewenvironment{coderust}
  {\lstset{style=coloredRust}}
  {}

  {\lstset{style=coloredRust,float=ht}}
  {}



%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
% Velosiraptor Specification Language Definition
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%


\lstdefinelanguage{Vrs}{%
  sensitive%
, morecomment=[l]{//}%
, morecomment=[s]{/*}{*/}%
, moredelim=[s][{\itshape\color[rgb]{0,0,0.75}}]{\#[}{]}%
, morestring=[b]{"}%
, alsodigit={}%
, alsoother={}%
, alsoletter={!}%
%
%
% [1] reserve keywords
% [2] traits
% [3] primitive types
% [4] type and value constructors
% [5] identifier
%
, morekeywords={break, continue, else, for, if, in, loop, match, return, while}  % control flow keywords
, morekeywords={as, const, let, move, mut, ref, static}  % in the context of variables
, morekeywords={unit, fn, requires, ensures, forall, exists}  % in the context of declarations
, morekeywords={Register, Memory, MMIO, CPURegister}  % in the context of declarations
%
% grep 'pub trait [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*' -r . | sed 's/^.*pub trait \([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*\).*/\1/g' | sort -u | tr '\n' ',' | sed 's/^\(.*\),$/{\1}\n/g' | sed 's/,/, /g'
, morekeywords=[2]{Layout, ReadAction, WriteAction}
%
, morekeywords=[3]{inaddr, outaddr, flags,size, int, nat}  % primitive types
%
, morekeywords=[4]{true, false}  % prelude value constructors
%
, morekeywords=[4]{state, interface}  % prelude value constructors
}

\lstdefinestyle{coloredvrs}
{
  % set the langauge
  language=Vrs
  % set the base style
  , style = common
  % keyword styles for differnt rust components
  , keywordstyle=\bfseries% reserved keywords
  , keywordstyle=[2]\color[rgb]{0.75, 0, 0}% traits
  , keywordstyle=[3]\color[rgb]{0, 0.5, 0}% primitive types
  , keywordstyle=[4]\color[rgb]{0, 0.5, 0}% type and value constructors
  , keywordstyle=[5]\color[rgb]{0, 0, 0.75}% macros
  %
  % if you want to delete keywords from the given language
  % , deletekeywords={...}
  % if you want to add more keywords to the set
  % , morekeywords={*,...}
  % some additional comments
  , morecomment=[l]{\//},
}

\lstnewenvironment{codevrs}
  {\lstset{style=coloredvrs}}
  {}

\newcommand{\inlinecodevrs}[1]{\lstinline[style=coloredVrs]{#1}}

\lstnewenvironment{codevrsfloat}[1]
  {\lstset{style=coloredvrs,float=ht, #1}}
  {}

% Velosiraptor Specification Language Definition
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%


\lstdefinelanguage{Scheme}{%
  morekeywords=[1]{define, define-syntax, define-macro, lambda, define-stream, stream-lambda},
  morekeywords=[2]{begin, call-with-current-continuation, call/cc,
    call-with-input-file, call-with-output-file, case, cond,
    do, else, for-each, if,
    let*, let, let-syntax, letrec, letrec-syntax,
    let-values, let*-values,
    and, or, not, delay, force,
    quasiquote, quote, unquote, unquote-splicing,
    map, fold, syntax, syntax-rules, eval, environment, query },
  morekeywords=[3]{import, export},
  alsodigit=!\$\%&*+-./:<=>?@^_~,
  sensitive=true,
  morecomment=[l]{;},
  morecomment=[s]{\#|}{|\#},
  morestring=[b]",
  basicstyle=\small\ttfamily,
  keywordstyle=\bf\ttfamily\color[rgb]{0,.3,.7},
  commentstyle=\color[rgb]{0.133,0.545,0.133},
  stringstyle={\color[rgb]{0.75,0.49,0.07}},
  upquote=true,
  breaklines=true,
  breakatwhitespace=true,
  literate=*{`}{{`}}{1},
  showstringspaces=false
}

{

  % some additional comments

}

\lstnewenvironment{codescheme}
  {\lstset{style=coloredscheme}}
  {}
